h1: How to Import Kurtis from India to the UK Wholesale (Now 0% Duty)
lead: Run a boutique or online store in the UK? Since the UK–India trade agreement came into force in July 2026, Indian-made kurtis and suits can enter the UK duty-free. Here is how duty, VAT, documents and labelling work – and how to order from a Jaipur manufacturer.
seo_title: Import Kurtis from India to UK Wholesale: 0% Duty Guide (2026)
seo_description: UK boutiques can now import Indian kurtis duty-free under the UK–India trade agreement. Duty, 20% VAT, EORI, origin proof, labelling and MOQ 15–20 pieces from Jaipur.
body:
## Quick answer

Under the **UK–India Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA)**, in force since **15 July 2026**, women's garments made in India (HS chapter 62, such as kurtis, kurta sets and Anarkali suits) can be imported into the UK at **0% customs duty**, down from the standard **12%**. You still pay **20% import VAT**, which VAT-registered businesses can usually reclaim. You need a **GB EORI number** and **proof of Indian origin** to claim the 0% rate.

## Duty and VAT at a glance

| Item | UK rule |
|---|---|
| Standard duty (MFN) | 12% |
| Duty for Indian-origin goods under CETA | **0%** |
| Import VAT | 20% (reclaimable if VAT registered) |
| Low-value parcels | Consignments of £135 or less have duty relief and VAT is charged at the point of sale; this relief is due to end by October 2028 |
| Typical express transit from India | About 3–5 working days |

## Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** (Importer Exporter Code) on the Indian side – we have this
- Your **GB EORI** number
- **Proof of origin** for the 0% CETA rate: an origin declaration from the exporter, a certificate of origin, or the importer's own knowledge, as the agreement allows

## Labelling

UK law requires **fibre content** labels on textile products (Textile Products (Labelling and Fibre Composition) Regulations 2012). Care and country-of-origin labels are good practice. We can stitch your own labels with the correct fibre content.

## Step by step

1. Choose styles from our catalogue, or send your own designs
2. Approve a sample (7–8 days)
3. Pay 50% advance; we produce in about 15 days for 100 pieces
4. We ship by express courier with the invoice and origin documents
5. Your courier or broker clears customs at 0% duty plus VAT

*This guide is general information for buyers, not legal or customs advice. Duty rates depend on the exact HS code and fabric, and rules change, so always confirm with your customs broker or courier before importing. Information checked November 2026.*

faq.q: Is there import duty on kurtis from India to the UK?
faq.a: Since 15 July 2026, Indian-origin women's garments can enter the UK at 0% duty under the UK–India CETA, if you have proof of origin. Without it the standard rate is 12%. Import VAT of 20% still applies.

faq.q: Do I need an EORI number to import kurtis to the UK?
faq.a: Yes. Businesses importing goods into Great Britain need a GB EORI number.

faq.q: What is the minimum order from Bahe Kurtiz?
faq.a: 15 to 20 pieces per design, and sizes can be mixed.

faq.q: Can you put my brand label on the kurtis?
faq.a: Yes. We offer private label with your neck labels, care labels, hang tags and packaging.
